## Workload

The grader review G05 for 2019 Q3 records the workload completed by Elif Sahin. A total of 215 sets were graded over 458 hours, giving a rate of 0.5 per hour. This provides the workload measure for the quarter and indicates the volume completed against the time recorded.

The figures have been reviewed by Priya Anand. They are presented as the basis for the workload assessment and are retained without adjustment.

## Quality

Quality checking was undertaken on 16 of the graded sets. The recorded agreement result was 68.8 per cent. This result reflects the comparison undertaken through the review sample and is included as the quarter’s quality measure.

The review does not identify any further action for 2019 Q3. Priya Anand completed the review of the workload and quality information for Elif Sahin.
